notes.title: Spooky New Halloween Maps: Phantom Pass & Dimensional Nightmare! 🎃👻
notes.content:
Greetings, Commanders!

The Quantum Conflict has undergone a spooky transformation for the Halloween season! We're excited to introduce two new maps that are full of tricks, treats, and terrifying surprises: Phantom Pass and Dimensional Nightmare!

🎃 Phantom Pass:


 Halloween Overhaul: We've revamped Phantom Pass with creepy Halloween colors, turning the lightning clouds and barriers into chilling sights.
 Ghost Mechanic: Beware the ghostly apparitions! The new ghost mechanic lets you pass through obstacles, but don’t let your guard down...
 Spiderweb Slowdown Zones: Watch out for webs that’ll slow your movement—spooky and strategic!
 Spiders & Skeletons: Collide with these creepy crawlers and lose health—spiders nibble away at you, and skeletons deal a haunting half-health blow!
 Pumpkin Asteroids & Planets: Navigate through eerie pumpkin-themed space objects for the ultimate Halloween experience.
 Halloween Soundtrack: Immerse yourself with 3 brand-new Halloween tracks, eerie sound effects, and spooky background props.



👻 Dimensional Nightmare:


 Dimensional Chaos: This map takes the spook factor up a notch! Along with the ghost mechanic, the level features randomized visual effects that will keep you on your toes as the environment cycles unpredictably.
 Halloween Theme: Themed visuals, colors, and haunting sounds to fully embrace the nightmare.



Gather your courage, commanders, and dive into these terrifying new levels. Whether you're in the mood for spooky sights or battling in eerie dimensions, we've got your Halloween gaming experience covered! 👻

Join the event now and show us your best Halloween-themed battles! 🎃

notes.title: Small Update Now Live!

notes.title: Main Branch Update Now Live!
notes.content:
Hello Quantum Conflict Community!

We’re thrilled to announce that the latest update is now officially live on the main branch. After extensive testing and refining, the Chase Cam, new weapon types, and several other improvements have been rolled out for everyone to enjoy. Here’s a quick look at what’s included:

New Features:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849151/90ff631810aab4a373024dd0a1bbf5d513df7466.png

Chase Cam: Experience the action from an all-new third-person perspective. This camera mode brings you closer to the cosmic chaos, adding a fresh layer of immersion to your gameplay.

New Weapon Types:


 Burst Fire: Unleash a rapid volley of your ship's primary projectile in just 0.5 seconds. Perfect for those intense moments when every second counts.
 Spin Fire: Take down enemies from all directions! Your ship spins and fires a barrage of primary projectiles, covering a wide area with destruction.


Gameplay Enhancements:


 New Camera Control Options: Easily toggle between camera modes directly from your keyboard or gamepad for a seamless experience.
 Improved Boss Mechanics: Boss encounters have been adjusted for better visibility and engagement, ensuring that each battle is as thrilling as it is challenging.
 UI Enhancements: We've added new canvas images to better communicate camera updates and other in-game changes, enhancing your overall user experience.


Fixes and Tweaks:


 Camera Bug Fixes: We’ve squashed bugs related to the Chase Cam, ensuring a smoother, more consistent experience across all gameplay modes.
 Performance Optimizations: Numerous behind-the-scenes improvements have been made to enhance performance and reduce any stuttering, particularly with the new camera mode.
 Miscellaneous Bug Fixes: Various other fixes, including HUD adjustments and UI fixes, have been implemented based on your feedback.


New Content:

Missions: Added two new challenging missions to test your skills.


Thank you for your continued support and feedback. This update wouldn’t be possible without your valuable input. Dive in, explore the changes, and as always, let us know what you think!

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Exciting Beta Branch Update Now Live!
notes.content:
Hello Quantum Conflict Community!

We're excited to announce that a major update is now live on the beta branch. We've been hard at work, and your feedback has been invaluable in shaping these improvements. Here’s what you can expect:

New Features:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849151/90ff631810aab4a373024dd0a1bbf5d513df7466.png

Chase Cam: Our new third-person camera mode offers a fresh, immersive perspective on the action. Get up close and personal with your ship and the cosmic battles. While playing solo, toggle the camera mode at any time with "C" on keyboard or "Y" on gamepad.

Gameplay Enhancements:

Improved Boss Mechanics: Boss encounters have been refined for better visibility and engagement, especially with the new Chase Cam.
Endless Mode Improvements: Various tweaks and fixes have been made to enhance your experience in Endless Mode.
Lighting Adjustments: Enhanced lighting for a more visually appealing and immersive experience.

Fixes and Tweaks:

Performance Optimizations: Numerous tweaks to ensure smoother gameplay.
Visual Updates: Improved particle effects and readability for several ships to enhance your visual experience.
Bug Fixes: Addressed several issues, including camera bugs, UI selections, and graphical glitches.

New Content:

Missions: Added two new challenging missions to test your skills.


We encourage you to join the beta branch and share your feedback on these updates. Your input helps us continually improve Quantum Conflict. These changes will be rolled out to the main branch in the near future!

Thank you for your ongoing support, and happy gaming!

notes.title: Galactic Update: Shields, Missions, and Performance Boost!
notes.content:
🚀 Game Update: Minor Changes & Improvements! 🚀

Hello Pilots!

We've just rolled out a new update with some exciting improvements and additions to enhance your gameplay experience. Check out what's new:

Shield Updates:

Fast Shield: Now recharges your energy faster, making it more useful in combat.
Rewind Shield: No longer rewinds the ship triggering it, allowing for better tactical use.
Shield Spam Prevention: Pressing the shield button will now burn at least one second of shield time to prevent very short spamming of the shield.

New Missions:

We've added fresh new missions to keep your adventures in the cosmos exciting!

Performance Optimization:

Improved game performance for smoother and more responsive gameplay.
We value your feedback! Let us know how these changes affect your gameplay and if you have any suggestions for future updates. Your input helps us make The Quantum Conflict the best it can be.

Happy gaming!

notes.title: The Quantum Conflict: Fully Playable on Steam Deck!
notes.content:
Hello Quantum Pilots!

We are thrilled to announce that The Quantum Conflict is fully playable on the Steam Deck! Our team has worked diligently to ensure that you can enjoy our game on this incredible handheld device. Here are a few details about the Steam Deck compatibility:


 Full Playability: You can play The Quantum Conflict from start to finish on the Steam Deck without any major issues.
 Performance: While the game is fully playable, there are instances where the frame rate might drop slightly. We are aware of this and are actively working on optimizations to improve performance over the coming week.


Your feedback is invaluable to us, and we appreciate your patience as we make these enhancements. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please don't hesitate to share them with us on our community hub.

Thank you for your continued support!

The Quantum Conflict Team

notes.title: Content Update: Introducing the Meteor Blitz Arena!
notes.content:
Greetings, Space Commanders!

We're excited to bring you another thrilling update to The Quantum Conflict – a brand-new map in the custom conflicts mode that promises to ramp up the excitement to astronomical levels!

🌠 Introducing "Meteor Blitz"! 🌠

Get ready for an intense cosmic battle like never before. In the Meteor Blitz arena, asteroids rain down at high speeds, turning the battlefield into a deadly dance of destruction. Your piloting skills will be put to the ultimate test as you dodge, weave, and outmaneuver both foes and fiery meteors!


Key Features of the Meteor Blitz Arena:

Asteroid Assault: Brace yourself for a relentless barrage of asteroids that hurtle into the play area, causing significant damage on impact. Keep your eyes peeled and your thrusters ready!

High-Speed Havoc: The meteors don’t just fall – they blitz into the arena at breakneck speeds, making each encounter a pulse-pounding challenge.

Dynamic Danger: Every second counts as you navigate through this hazardous environment. The ever-present threat of incoming meteors adds a new layer of strategy and excitement to every skirmish.

Intense Space Combat: With asteroids causing chaos and destruction, each battle becomes a thrilling test of reflexes and tactics. Can you outfly the meteor storm and your opponents?

We’re eager for you to dive into Meteor Blitz and experience this exhilarating addition to your space combat adventures. Rally your crew, power up your ships, and prepare for the most intense battles yet!

Join the fray and keep an eye out for more exciting updates coming your way!

Safe travels, Commanders!

FlashPoint Games

notes.content:

Intense Combat: With the ring posing a constant threat, every encounter with your friends becomes a test of skill and nerve.

We can't wait for you to dive into the Death Ring and experience this electrifying new twist on space combat. Rally your crew, jump into the fray, and may the best pilot win!

Join the fight and stay tuned for more exciting updates coming your way! 

Safe travels, Commanders!

FlashPoint Games
